description:
You are a security researcher at a digital rights NGO preparing reference materials for a training workshop on secure communications. You need to obtain the official Tor Project specification documents for offline use. Complete the following:

1. Navigate to 'https://spec.torproject.org/' (the official Tor Protocol Specifications page)
2. Find and download the 'Tor directory protocol, version 3' specification (it should be a downloadable file, likely a .txt file linked from that page)
3. Save the file to /home/ga/Documents/ with the filename 'tor-dir-spec.txt'
4. Also navigate to 'https://www.torproject.org/about/history/' to read about Tor's history
5. Bookmark the Tor specifications index page (https://spec.torproject.org/) in the Bookmarks menu with the title 'Tor Protocol Specifications'
6. Set the Tor Browser download directory to /home/ga/Documents/ (in Settings > General > Files and Applications > Downloads)

Note: If the download automatically saves to /home/ga/Downloads/, you will need to move or rename it to the correct location /home/ga/Documents/tor-dir-spec.txt. The file must exist at that exact path when the task is complete.
